meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看不懂的代码库、命令或改动拆成一步步图解,讲给完全不懂的人听
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队里有人不是工程师,却需要快速弄懂某段代码或某次改动。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if someone on your team must grasp code without being an engineer.

howto.what: 它会把你指定的代码、文件夹、功能、命令或 PR 讲给完全不懂的人听。产出是一份 PR Lens 画布:画面从两个方框开始,一步步长到完整,读者打开链接按播放观看,不读段落。最后它只回你一句答案和链接。
howto.when: 当你输入 /eli5 <某个东西>,或要求把代码讲得简单些、讲给新手或非工程背景的人听,或说「像给五岁小孩讲」时,它会接管。

say.note: 会生成画布链接,并只回你一句答案。

say.text: 把这个 PR 讲给完全不懂代码的同事听
say.note: 生成逐步展开的 PR Lens 画布。

say.text: /eli5 这个命令怎么工作,新同事要入门
say.note: 产出一份按顺序播放的讲解画布链接。

howto.what_en: When asked, it explains a codebase, folder, feature, command or PR to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas that grows from two boxes to the full picture, step by step. You get one sentence and a link.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /eli5 <thing>, or when asked to explain code simply, to a beginner or non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'.

say_en.note: It builds the canvas and replies with one sentence and the link.

say_en.text: Explain this PR to a teammate who knows nothing about code
say_en.note: A growing PR Lens canvas is generated.

say_en.text: /eli5 how this command works, for onboarding a new hire
say_en.note: Produces a step-by-step walkthrough canvas link.
